title: Masters' face-to-face contact with future humans at a Phoenix conference
summary: Mike Masters tells of Masters' face-to-face contact with future humans at a Phoenix conference, about about 2022 (Halloween, about a year before the interview) at conference hotel, Phoenix, Arizona, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.
